name: Insecure Temporary File
attack_scenario: a predictable temp path (mktemp / hardcoded /tmp/name) lets a local attacker pre-create or symlink the file between the name being chosen and it being opened, hijacking or corrupting its contents (TOCTOU)
negative_test_hint: pre-create the predicted temp path as a symlink to "/etc/passwd" and assert the program refuses to follow it

exemplar.compliant:
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
    f.write(data)
exemplar.explanation: use mkstemp/NamedTemporaryFile which create the file atomically with a private name and O_EXCL
